description: Deterministic dataset and SQL analytics tools for Supervisor / Chief Analyst Agent.

tools.name: load_dataset
tools.description: Load CSV, XLSX, JSON or Parquet file from DATA_INPUT_DIR and store it as a parquet dataset artifact.
tools.input_summary: source_type, path, format, dataset_name, overwrite, options

tools.name: inspect_schema
tools.description: Inspect parquet artifact schema and column-level metadata without returning the full dataset.

tools.name: preview_dataset
tools.description: Return a bounded head, tail or sample preview with optional PII masking.
tools.output_summary: status, dataset_id, rows_returned, preview, pii_detected, warnings

tools.name: profile_quality
tools.description: Compute a basic deterministic data quality profile.

tools.name: safe_sql_preview
tools.description: Validate SQL without executing it and report whether it is read-only.

tools.name: safe_sql_query
tools.description: Execute read-only SQL against a registered dataset through DuckDB and store result as parquet artifact.
tools.output_summary: status, dataset_id, result_artifact_uri, rows_returned, preview, execution_ms

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List registered datasets from metadata registry.
tools.output_summary: dataset_id, artifact_uri, rows, columns, created_at, source_format, pii_columns
